senses.gloss:
m. f. [ऋष्-करणे-क्तिन्] 
__1 A double-edged sword. [[Mb. 1. 194. 7.]] 
__2 A sword (in general). [[Bhāg. 8. 10. 36.]] 
__3 Any weapon (as a spear or lance &c). 
__4 A kind of musical instrument; सतालवीणामुरजर्ष्टिवेणुभिः [[Bhāg. 3. 15. 21.]] 
-Comp. 
-विद्युत् a. shining with weapons.
a. Furnished with spears (as the Maruts).
